name: The Overlord's lens
description: an object, not a creature: a single jagged shard of thick red lens glass the size of a shield, propped upright on a small heap of black rubble, glowing deep red from inside with cracks of light in it; clear empty glass, no figure, no face, no person inside it

poses.stand: standing upright on its rubble, glowing dull red

idle.action: pulses with a dull red glow, light shifting inside the glass
